what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as accounts.audit, opened Money > Books and found the obvious 'Add supplier bill' button. First click showed 'Loading bill form...' forever plus a red toast 'filePreviewsHtml is not defined'. Retries (close/reopen, refresh button) never showed a bill form; later clicks just left the page unchanged with no message. I then tried the + (New) menu > 'Cost or purchase', which opens 'Record expense or purchase' (Project, Type, Description, Amount, Vendor/supplier, 'Send for approval') but has no date, no payment method/bank transfer, and no way to say it is unpaid; I cancelled without submitting because it could not represent the requested record. Nothing was saved.
incorrect_navigation_attempts: + (New) menu > Cost or purchase: form lacks date and payment method, goes straight to approval
unnecessary_steps: Repeated open/close of the bill form hoping it would load
confusing_terminology: Record payment vs Add supplier bill vs Cost or purchase -> unclear which records money owed
Type: Incurred expense / Purchase order / commitment -> unclear which means a bill owed
Home shows vendor 'Shree Tiles Pvt Ltd' while task says 'Shree Tiles' -> unclear if same vendor
Send for approval -> unclear what happens or who approves
missing_feedback: Add supplier bill: form stays on 'Loading bill form...' with no recovery or retry
Later clicks on Add supplier bill give no visible response or error
Inbox badge count changes (1/0/2/0) without explanation
unexpected_behaviour: Add supplier bill form never loads
Page seems to re-render and close the form on its own
visual_issues: Error toast is a raw technical message, covers content bottom-right

observations: The main route to the objective (Money > Books > Add supplier bill) is easy to find but broken by a script error. The alternative New > Cost or purchase form cannot capture payment method or date, so the objective as written cannot be completed with what I could reach. Home and Books pages were clear and tidy.

rating_justifications.workflow_efficiency: Could not complete the task; alternative form lacks date and payment method fields.
rating_justifications.system_feedback: Silent failure on later clicks, raw technical error on first, inbox badge changing without cause.
rating_justifications.error_recovery: No retry or guidance after the error; closing and reopening did not help.
